title: Meridian universal role registry
description: The complete schema for the built-in, product-neutral catalogue of universal engineering roles (record_type: role-registry). The catalogue is ONE scoped record: it declares THIS schema in its $schema and composes the reused scoped-record.schema.json envelope (identity, scope, origin, authority) with a specialised body, so a consumer that follows the declaration validates the whole record in one pass; scripts/lib/role-and-human-control.mjs additionally validates every record against scoped-record.schema.json directly, so the canonical envelope check is reused and separately performed, never dropped. The catalogue is Kernel methodology: it lives ONLY in scope.type built-in-methodology (scope.id built-in-methodology), origin.kind built-in and authority.kind methodology-owner; a concrete run's role assignments are a different record (human-control.schema.json) in run-state. The payload is a CLOSED object carrying exactly one axis, roles: the closed pool owner, operator, executor, reviewer, verifier, git_integrator, deployer — every role present exactly once, each with a Russian title, a one-line summary and at least one responsibility. A role definition names powers and responsibilities only: a concrete programme, an AI model, a vendor or a person's name is never part of a universal role and is rejected as an extra field. The rules this JSON Schema subset cannot state live in scripts/lib/role-and-human-control.mjs: the declared $schema is RESOLVED as a LOGICAL address within the Meridian namespace and must resolve to exactly this file (resolution and the rooted-path rules are REUSED from scripts/lib/task-specification.mjs, no divergent copy); the seven roles are all present and none is duplicated; every text string is portable (no rooted machine path, no drive-letter path, no backslash path, no ~/ reference, no file:// URL); the human-readable name is Russian. The contract is a mandatory part of the Kernel: an absent schema, catalogue or fixtures is a validator FAIL, not an informational skip. The normative document is standards/workspace/role-and-human-control.md.

scope_ref.description: The built-in role catalogue lives only in built-in-methodology; every other workspace-scope-model area is rejected here and in scripts/lib/role-and-human-control.mjs with the rationale.

origin.description: Same contract as scoped-record.schema.json's origin. The catalogue is shipped with the methodology, so kind is built-in and no source_ref is carried.

authority.description: Same contract as scoped-record.schema.json's authority; the catalogue is methodology-owner authority.

role.description: One universal role. id is from the closed pool. title is the Russian name. summary is a one-line statement of the role. responsibilities is a non-empty list of the powers and duties the role carries. No programme, model, vendor or person name — those are a concrete run's assignment, not a universal definition.

payload.description: The catalogue body: the closed pool of universal roles as a CLOSED object with exactly one axis. Exactly seven roles, each id from the pool, none repeated; full coverage and non-duplication are also checked in scripts/lib/role-and-human-control.mjs.
